title: LLM Integration for Enterprise: A Practical Buyer's Guide (Sinhala)

author.name: Daniel Lee
author.bio: Cloud architect who has designed and delivered LLM integration projects for enterprise clients across multiple industries.

metaDescription: Enterprise LLM integration සඳහා ප්‍රායෝගික buyer's guide: model selection, data privacy, cost modeling, vendor comparison, සහ integration architecture patterns.
content:
හැඳින්වීම

Enterprise LLM integration 2024 සිට significantly mature වී ඇත. බොහෝ organizations ට ප්‍රශ්නය AI integrate කළ යුතු ද යන්න නොව safely, cost-effectively, measurable business value deliver කරමින් ක්‍රියාත්මකව කළ හැකිද යන්නය.

Model selection (Claude Sonnet cost/performance sweet spot), data privacy architecture (zero data retention recommended), cost modeling (token costs compound), සහ enterprise integration patterns (RAG, workflow automation, AI copilots) — enterprise LLM integration සඳහා key considerations.

සාරාංශය

Successful enterprise LLM integration clear problem definition, regulatory context සඳහා right data privacy architecture, සහ real usage assumptions based cost model දී ආරම්භ වේ. Zero data retention, mid-tier model, සහ prompt caching දී ආරම්භ කරන්න. වැඩිදුර විස්තර සඳහා ඉංග්‍රීසි සංස්කරණය කියවන්න.
